subject: [PATCH 12/60] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted a duplicate message with identical content to their own initial post. This appears to be an error or a test of some sort, as there is no meaningful discussion or analysis provided.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict reclaim operations to common memory nodes, improving the efficiency of memory management and reducing fragmentation. The changes involve modifying kswapd's behavior at boot and hotplug events, as well as updating MGLRU's debugfs interface to iterate over common nodes instead of all memory nodes.
